title: Homeomorphism of the Revuz correspondence under Dynkin class assumptions
summary: This paper investigates the topological properties of the Revuz correspondence between positive continuous additive functionals (PCAFs) and their associated smooth measures. Within the Dynkin, local Dynkin, and Green-tight Dynkin classes, we establish bidirectional equivalences among measure convergence, potential convergence, and PCAF convergence.
